$comment: Third-party skills and where they come from. NONE is stored in this repository: the 26 that used to sit under vendor/ now live in optional pack repositories, specified by packs/ and attached per Project. This file records what is NOT packaged, plus the multi-agent install behaviour worth knowing about.

orca-cli.reason: DROPPED from the toolkit, on evidence from the tree rather than from a README. Its SKILL.md is a 46-line discovery stub whose entire body resolves an `orca` executable and then asks it for the real guide, so without the binary there is no degraded mode -- there is nothing. No orca, orca-ide or orca-dev was on PATH and ORCA_CLI_COMMAND was unset in the environment where it would most often load. Nothing in this repository depended on it. At 642 description characters it was the second most expensive description of the 27, and it is the only one with no upstream plugin: stablyai/orca ships no .claude-plugin at all.
orca-cli.stillWorksWhere: A machine with Orca installed. That is a local-install concern; link it from an Orca checkout if you want it there.
orca-cli.toReinstate: add a packs/orca.json with the pin above and build it like any other pack

find-skills.reason: Present in ~/.agents/skills but NOT linked into ~/.claude/skills, so it is not available to Claude Code locally either. Vendoring it would add a capability rather than port one. Add a pack spec under packs/ if that changes.

ui-ux-pro-max.reason: A real directory in ~/.claude/skills duplicating what the ui-ux-pro-max plugin ships. Vendoring it would fork a plugin's own content for no gain. LOCAL DELIVERY IS REVIEWED, NOT VERIFIED: profile/plugins.json records installedLocally 2.5.0, which is installation, not skill delivery, and no test here invokes the skill through the plugin. That is the load-bearing half of this decision and it carries no measurement. IN CLOUD, on 2026-09-20, in Anthropic's hosted environment, a fresh session with this plugin declared in .claude/settings.json installed zero plugins (docs/host-integration.md, profile/plugins.json cloudObservation). This field previously said the plugin was declared in .claude/settings.json and installs in cloud; neither half was true by then -- the keys had moved to profile/plugins.json and the measurement had already been taken. Scope: that environment, that date. It is not a claim about cloud sessions generally; profile/plugins.json claimTiers marks the universal version NOT ESTABLISHED. Project settings -> Plugins is the documented route for a cloud project that wants it; that route is DOCUMENTED, NOT MEASURED here.

ecc skills (181).reason: Delivered by the ecc plugin locally, which is why they are not packaged. LOCAL DELIVERY IS REVIEWED, NOT VERIFIED, on the same footing as ui-ux-pro-max above: profile/plugins.json records installedLocally 1.10.0, which is installation rather than skill delivery. IN CLOUD, on 2026-09-20, in Anthropic's hosted environment, ecc@ecc was measured NOT INSTALLED and its marketplace never registered (docs/host-integration.md, profile/plugins.json cloudObservation). This field previously said the plugin is declared in .claude/settings.json; it is not, and the keys are in profile/plugins.json. Scope: that environment, that date, not cloud sessions generally. Project settings -> Plugins is the documented route, DOCUMENTED and not measured here.

externalAudit.$comment: Provenance for the Phase 2 external-source audit, so it is not repeated. The full report is a working document outside this repository; only what a future reader needs in order NOT to re-audit is kept here. HEADLINE: ten repositories, roughly 1,410 skill-shaped files, ZERO new canonical-core candidates and nothing proposed for text reuse. Five clauses belonged inside existing skills and three were orchestration principles; those landed in Phase 2A. This record is provenance for later external-capability work, not a decision to import anything.
externalAudit.method: Every repository read from its own cloned tree, never from a README or a web page: git clone --depth 1 --filter=tree:0, then git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD, then SKILL.md bodies read in full. Plain HTTPS to github.com and codeload.github.com are proxy-denied in this environment, so no summary-fetching route existed.
externalAudit.refCaveat: auditedRef is what the audit recorded at the time. Where refIsCompleteSha is false the ref is an abbreviated commit id, and where auditedRef is null the audit recorded no commit id at all -- it read that repository at its HEAD on the audit date. A null is NOT a licence to substitute today's HEAD: today's HEAD is a different claim about a different tree. Re-resolve and record a full sha before relying on any of these for a build.
externalAudit.categories: The six buckets the audit placed every item into: canonical-core candidate; extension of an existing canonical skill; optional domain pack; workflow or orchestration idea; host or tooling capability; redundant or reject.

result.deliveryNote: None of the ten carries .claude/skills/ entries; all deliver by plugin manifest. Containing skill-shaped markdown and delivering skills are different claims.

repositories.category: optional domain pack at most; ideas only
repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. Corroborates checkable-findings (diagnosing-superpowers discards findings lacking a path:line) and the repair half of adversarial-review (receiving-code-review). Delivery is plugin-and-marketplace only; no .claude/skills/ anywhere in the tree.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Jesse Vincent; LICENSE verbatim. Five of its seven plugin manifests redeclare MIT; .muse-plugin and .hermes-plugin declare none. No per-file headers on any of the 15 SKILL.md files.

repositories.category: optional domain pack; redundant for core
repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. Drift against our own record: this manifest pins ECC at 1.10.0 with 181 skills; HEAD at audit was 2.2.2 with 292.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Affaan Mustafa, WITH eight per-skill Apache-2.0 overrides among 18 skills carrying their own license key. The licence picture is REVIEWED, NOT EXHAUSTIVELY ESTABLISHED: the frontmatter capture the audit's coverage rests on did not record license: lines. COVERAGE: 31 of 292 skill bodies were read; 173 were never opened. Do not restate either wider than this.

repositories.category: workflow or orchestration idea; ideas only
repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. 169 tracked files, 38 skills. Its diagnosing-bugs (a red-capable reproduction BEFORE any hypothesis) is part of the evidence that causal-establishment is the strongest later canonical candidate; it does not decide it.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Matt Pocock; no per-skill overrides. Its in-progress/pr skill carries a frontmatter metadata.credits block naming its upstream -- the attribution shape worth copying even when nothing else is.

repositories.category: optional domain pack; excluded on context budget
repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. 818 domain skills; the skill-list budget answers the question by itself.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: Apache-2.0 but NOT uniformly: 817 per-skill LICENSE files for 818 skills, in three distinct byte-forms -- 814 identical, two truncated Apache stubs, and skills/conducting-gdpr-compliance-assessment/LICENSE naming a DIFFERENT copyright holder (dakshverma23). Check the specific file; at least one is not the maintainer's to license.

repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. Its hypothesis-generation (rivals before tests, pre-timestamping against HARKing) is the other half of the causal-establishment evidence.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: THE LICENSING FINDING OF THE AUDIT. The root MIT badge is not accurate for a material fraction of the tree: per-skill frontmatter carries at least nine regimes including GPLv3, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and PolyForm-Noncommercial. Four skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) are unmodified Anthropic content whose bundled LICENSE.txt forbids extraction, derivative works and distribution -- those cannot be reused at all, under any structure. Read each file's own frontmatter before reusing anything.

MIT CLAIMED, NOT SHIPPED: asserted in the README, in SKILL.md frontmatter and in plugin.json, with NO LICENSE file anywhere in the tree. The plugin metadata also names a different owner (forrestchang) and a different location than the repository cloned -- unresolved. DO NOT REUSE.

repositories.category: workflow or orchestration idea; ideas only
repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. A tips collection with one workflow idea. Its agent-browser reproduces the orca-cli failure mode -- a skill resolving a binary that is not present.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Shayan Rais, FOR THE REPOSITORY'S OWN MATERIAL ONLY. Most of the content is explicitly attributed to third parties -- named individuals' posts and reproduced screenshots. The repository's licence conveys no rights in aggregated material.

repositories.category: workflow or orchestration idea; ideas only
repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. Two ideas worth taking; its trace carries an evidence-strength ordering, which is part of why evidence-verification gained one in Phase 2A. Every body in it fails portability as text.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Yeachan Heo. Moot in practice: portability excludes every body.

repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate. 1,243 tracked files. A memory system with a skill surface -- the clearest case of the tool-versus-skill-source distinction. Its pathfinder requires file:line per node and at least two citations per duplication claim, corroborating checkable-findings from the opposite side to superpowers.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: Apache-2.0, Copyright 2026 Alex Newman, WITH A NOTICE FILE. Apache-2.0 section 4 applies including propagating the NOTICE contents -- an obligation MIT does not carry.

repositories.disposition: No canonical candidate, and not a skill source: a tool. The only genuine host-layer capability found in the ten.
repositories.provenanceCaveat: Apache-2.0, Copyright 2024 rtk-ai and rtk-ai Labs; NO NOTICE file in the tree, so the NOTICE obligation does not arise here even though it does for claude-mem.

laterCandidateRecorded.name: causal-establishment
laterCandidateRecorded.status: RECORDED AS A CANDIDATE, NOT APPROVED AND NOT SCHEDULED
laterCandidateRecorded.note: The strongest later canonical candidate, to be reconsidered for dogfooding only after the seven-skill core has real usage evidence. Its subject is the epistemics of establishing a cause -- rival hypotheses named before testing, a reproduction that can fail before any hypothesis exists, and proof by intervention -- not debugging. Deliberately NOT added in Phase 2A.

multiAgentFanOut.$comment: The skills CLI installs into every detected agent directory, not just Claude Code. Recorded because a reinstall reproduces this fan-out and it explains why identical content exists in seven trees on this machine.
multiAgentFanOut.lockFileNote: Records source and a folder hash but NO commit pin, which is why each pack spec resolves its pin independently.

packs.where: packs/ holds the specifications; the content lives in its own repository
packs.attachment: per Project, never automatic. A Project that attaches neither pays for neither.
packs.delivery: .claude/skills/<name> -> skills/<name> inside the PACK repository. VERIFIED 2026-09-20 in two separate fresh cloud sessions with this repository absent: 13/13 skills discovered per pack, entries resolving, and a representative skill (wrangler, minimalist-ui) invoked through the Skill tool with its body injected from the pack's own .claude/skills base directory. Harness delivery, not filesystem readability.

cloudflare.head: 63a287f720e9da55e8a9c12b0c7a8925cdfd3811
cloudflare.headNote: Rebuilt 2026-09-21 from the same pin f96bff754e42, which was not moved, to add the PROVENANCE.json `files` block: a sha256 and mode for LICENSE, PACK.json and README.md, which --verify-pack previously checked for existence only. Measured against the previous head 883a3c47 before pushing: 482 tree entries on both sides, no path added or removed, PROVENANCE.json the only one differing, all 375 skill file digests and the whole `skills` block identical, the 13 .claude/skills entries and .agents/skills -> ../skills unchanged, and the same four turnstile-spin scripts at 0755 with no other mode changed. Git reports one file changed, +14 lines. schemaVersion stays 2; the format changed without a version bump, so 2 now denotes both shapes and the missing `files` key is what rejects the older one. 883a3c47 therefore FAILED --verify-pack (rc 1) until this rebuild. Verified offline from a fresh clone of THIS SHA (--verify-pack, rc 0).
cloudflare.deliveryVerifiedNote: The fresh-cloud delivery measurement above was taken against THIS SHA, not the current head. Skill names, content, layout and symlink topology are unchanged between the two, so the measurement is expected to carry over, but it has not been re-run.
